en.deck: Los Angeles has lost four straight and starts a five-game road trip at TD Garden, with Artemi Panarin listed day-to-day after missing Saturday's game for a death in his family. Boston has dropped two in a row by a combined 11-4 but is 8-3-0 at home. The market likes the Bruins more than the model does.
news: Panarin missed the 3-2 loss to Calgary on Saturday after his grandfather died. Erik Gustafsson has missed three games and Jakub Dvorak is out until at least Nov. 28.

Boston lost 5-2 to Montreal and 6-2 to Minnesota. Before that, no opponent had scored more than four goals against the Bruins this season.
Jeremy Swayman is the projected Bruins starter. The Kings' goalie was not confirmed overnight. James Hagens (back) is out until at least Nov. 21.
records: Los Angeles is 0-10-1 this season when it scores two goals or fewer, and 3-7-0 in its last 10.
David Pastrnak ended a four-game goal drought against Minnesota with his team-high ninth goal.

en.title: McDavid's 22-game point streak meets the Panthers in a Final rematch
en.deck: Edmonton has won five straight and has not lost in regulation on the road this season. Connor McDavid has a point in all 22 games and Leon Draisaitl leads the league with 20 goals. Florida is still waiting on Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, and the model and market both see a near coin flip.
news: McDavid leads the NHL with 53 points (12 goals, 41 assists). His 22-game point streak to open the season is tied for the fifth-longest in NHL history.
Draisaitl scored his league-leading 20th goal in Sunday's 5-2 win in Philadelphia and has points in nine straight games.
Barkov has played only two games this season and Marchand has been out since the second game. Florida Hockey Now says both could return as early as Tuesday, but neither is confirmed.
Jacob Markstrom is expected in the Florida net. Edmonton's starter was not confirmed overnight, and Ryan Nugent-Hopkins is day-to-day.
records: Matthew Tkachuk reached 700 career points on Sunday and leads Florida with 30 points.
Sam Reinhart leads the Panthers with 12 goals. Florida is 3-0-1 in its last four.
Edmonton's power play is converting about 34%, third in the league.
The last six meetings averaged 7.5 goals. Florida beat Edmonton in the 2024 and 2025 Stanley Cup Finals.
betting: Market: Panthers 1.83, Oilers 2.02, about 52–48 without the margin. The model has 54–46, a touch more on Florida, so the two mostly agree.

sv.deck: Columbus har förlorat fyra raka på full tid och tränaren Rick Bowness väntas missa en tredje match på grund av hälsoskäl. Islanders kommer hem med en friskare trupp, med Mathew Barzal tillbaka och två stora segrar på västresan. Marknaden värderar New York lite högre än modellen.

en.title: Gauthier takes a nine-game goal streak into St. Louis

sv.title: Gauthier tar med sig en målsvit på nio matcher till St. Louis
sv.deck: Cutter Gauthier har gjort mål i nio raka matcher, NHL:s längsta målsvit på 29 år och två från Teemu Selännes klubbrekord. Anaheim är 7-3-0 borta, medan St. Louis har gjort 1,9 mål per match de senaste tio. Modellen och marknaden har Blues som nästan exakt lika stora favoriter.
news: Gauthier har 18 mål, varav 10 i powerplay, och 14 mål bara i november, vilket placerar honom i sällskap med Wayne Gretzky och Mario Lemieux.

Joel Hofer har startat fyra raka för St. Louis och väntas göra det igen. Philip Broberg och Aleksanteri Kaskimaki är osäkra.
Mason McTavish möter sitt gamla lag för första gången sedan flytten till St. Louis.

en.title: The Wild chase a 12th straight game with a point
en.deck: Minnesota has earned a point in 11 straight games (9-0-2), three short of the club record, and allows a league-low 2.18 goals a game. Nashville's seven-game winning streak ended in San Jose on Sunday, but its penalty kill leads the league. The market makes the Wild a much bigger favourite than the model does.
news: Kirill Kaprizov has 20 points and Quinn Hughes 17 during Minnesota's point streak.

Brock Faber returned on Saturday from a skull fracture. Olli Maatta will miss at least a week.
Jonathan Marchessault (lower body), who has missed seven games, may return for Nashville. Juuse Saros played Sunday, and Nashville's starter was not confirmed overnight.
records: Minnesota has won eight straight road games and has not lost at home in regulation (5-0-2).
Nashville's penalty kill is at 90% and has killed 29 of 30 over its last 12 games.

sv.deck: Minnesota har tagit poäng i elva raka matcher (9-0-2), tre från klubbrekordet, och släpper in ligans lägsta 2,18 mål per match. Nashvilles svit på sju raka segrar bröts i San Jose i söndags, men lagets boxplay är ligans bästa. Marknaden gör Wild till betydligt större favoriter än modellen.

en.title: Mark Stone needs one point to own the Vegas scoring record
en.deck: Stone tied Jonathan Marchessault's franchise record of 417 points in Sunday's loss to Vancouver, so his next point sets a new mark. Dallas arrives after two one-goal wins and Jamie Benn's 1,000th point, but its defence is thin. These teams meet again on Thursday, and the model and market agree closely on this one.
news: Miro Heiskanen has missed five games and is questionable. Tyler Myers left Sunday's game with an upper-body injury, and Lian Bichsel is on injured reserve.
Benn reached 1,000 career points on Saturday, the second player in franchise history after Mike Modano.
Jake Oettinger posted his league-leading fourth shutout against Buffalo. Jason Robertson scored the overtime winner against Florida, his 11th goal.
Vegas has alternated Carter Hart and Adin Hill. Hart started Sunday, so Hill would be next, but it was not confirmed overnight. Noah Hanifin is out.
records: Stone reached 417 points with Vegas in 422 games. Marchessault needed 514.
Dallas allows 2.4 goals a game, third-best in the league, but ranks in the bottom third in scoring.
Only 30% of Dallas games have gone over 5.5 goals, the lowest rate on Tuesday's slate.
Vegas has the league's fourth-best power play (28.8%). Mitch Marner has 10 power-play points.
betting: Market: Golden Knights 1.72, Stars 2.18, about 56–44 without the margin. The model has 55–45, so the two agree.
Total: over 5.5 at 1.80 is about 53%. The model says 52%, also in line, with Dallas's low-scoring games pulling the other way from Vegas's power play.

sv.deck: Stone tangerade Jonathan Marchessaults klubbrekord på 417 poäng i söndagens förlust mot Vancouver, så hans nästa poäng blir nytt rekord. en.title: Celebrini and Smith lead the Sharks into a rematch with Calgary
en.deck: San Jose is 3-0-1 in its last four and ended Nashville's seven-game winning streak on Sunday, with three points each from Macklin Celebrini and Will Smith. Calgary was beaten 6-1 in Anaheim the night after a win in Los Angeles, and has lost Kevin Bahl for the season. The model sees a coin flip, while the market leans to San Jose.
news: Bahl ruptured his Achilles tendon and will not play again this season. Jonathan Huberdeau (hip surgery) did not travel.
Dustin Wolf won 3-2 in Los Angeles on Saturday. Devin Cooley allowed six goals in Anaheim on Sunday.
Alex Nedeljkovic made 32 saves against Nashville and is projected to start again. Kiefer Sherwood left Sunday's game with his arm in a sling.
No.2 overall pick Ivar Stenberg scored on the Sharks' top line on Sunday.
records: It was Celebrini's 26th career three-point game, tied with Dale Hawerchuk for fifth-most before turning 21.
San Jose is 6-0-2 when Celebrini and Smith both have three points.
Calgary has lost four of its last six and is 3-6-1 on the road, but has the league's fifth-best power play (27.1%).
Calgary won the first meeting 2-1 on Nov. 2. The last 12 meetings averaged 5.4 goals.
betting: Market: Sharks 1.77, Flames 2.08, about 54–46 without the margin. The model has it 50–50, warmer on Calgary than the price.

sv.deck: San Jose är 3-0-1 de senaste fyra och bröt Nashvilles svit på sju raka segrar i söndags, med tre poäng var av Macklin Celebrini och Will Smith. news: Bahl har slitit av hälsenan och spelar inte mer den här säsongen. Jonathan Huberdeau (höftoperation) reste inte med.
